references.text: The context of God's covenant with Phinehas, explaining why he receives the covenant of peace
The promise of an eternal priesthood, which also applies to Phinehas' descendants
Phinehas' action was credited to him as righteousness from generation to generation
God promises to establish a covenant of peace with His people
The prophecy of an eternal covenant of peace between God and Israel
God's covenant of peace shall not be shaken, a parallel to the eternal covenant with Phinehas
God's covenant with Levi concerning life and peace, which is connected to the covenant with Phinehas
The Levitical priesthood points forward to Christ's perfect priesthood
